dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: Heh... I'm not sure I'd say that, but at the same time, it's been a while since I last considered myself happy.

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: I'm an auditor here at the Palais. My work is confidential, so I can't really unburden myself of my complaints to anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: Of course, I fully intend to follow the rules, but sometimes I really do wish I had someone to talk to.

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: Maybe I need to take a different approach — learn to live with those things that don't go smoothly.
